source: Mozilla bug 2083449 (2026-10-17): the private keys of eight eMudhra intermediates were recoverable, so anyone could sign for any name through them. The roots they chain to, by SHA-256 fingerprint, as the incident's record lists them: https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/roots.json. `debian` names the file of Debian's ca-certificates that carries the root, where it does (20250419, the computer's pinned snapshot).
